            })

            end_date = frappe.utils.getdate(next_row.date)

# Safely convert values
paid = float(doc.emi_amount_paid or 0)
due = float(doc.emi_amount or 0)

# === PARTIAL PAYMENT HANDLING ===
if paid > 0 and paid < due and not doc.new_due_created:
    new_txn = frappe.new_doc("Transaction")
    new_txn.loan_file = doc.loan_file
    new_txn.product = doc.product
    new_txn.creation_date = frappe.utils.nowdate()
    new_txn.emi_id = doc.emi_id
    new_txn.date_due = doc.date_due
    new_txn.emi_amount = due - paid

    new_txn.payment_status = "Pending" if frappe.utils.nowdate() <= str(doc.date_due) else "Overdue"
    new_txn.payment_type = "Not paid"
    new_txn.customer_account_number = doc.customer_account_number
    new_txn.destination_bank_id = doc.destination_bank_id
    new_txn.customer_name = doc.customer_name
    new_txn.umrn = doc.umrn

    for row in doc.components:
        new_row = new_txn.append("components", {})
        new_row.component = row.component
        new_row.amount = float(row.amount_due or 0)

    new_txn.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    current_doc = frappe.get_doc("Transaction", doc.name)
    current_doc.payment_type = "Part Paid"
    current_doc.new_due_created = 1
    current_doc.transx_if_any = new_txn.name
    current_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

# === EXCESS PAYMENT HANDLING ===
elif paid > due and not doc.excess_amount_logged:
    excess = round(paid - due, 2)

    excess_doc = frappe.new_doc("Excess amount")  
    excess_doc.loan_file = doc.loan_file
    excess_doc.tranx = doc.name
    excess_doc.excess_amount = excess
    excess_doc.date_of_creation = frappe.utils.nowdate()
    excess_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    current_doc = frappe.get_doc("Transaction", doc.name)
    current_doc.payment_type = "Paid"
    current_doc.excess_amt_if_any = excess
    current_doc.excess_amount_logged = 1
    current_doc.excess_doc_if_any = excess_doc.name  
    current_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

loan_transactions = frappe.get_all("Loan Transactions", filters={"loan_file": ["!=", ""]}, fields=["name", "loan_file"])

for lt in loan_transactions:
    doc = frappe.get_doc("Loan Transactions", lt.name)

    doc.set("overall_transaction", [])
    doc.set("overdue", [])
    doc.set("interest", [])
    doc.set("principle", [])
    doc.set("charges", [])

    transactions = frappe.get_all("Transaction", filters={"loan_file": doc.loan_file}, fields=[
        "name", "type", "payment_type", "payment_status", "date_due",
        "emi_payment_date", "emi_amount_paid", "emi_amount"
    ])

    for txn in transactions:
        txn_doc = frappe.get_doc("Transaction", txn.name)

        charges_total = 0
        principle_total = 0
        interest_total = 0

        for comp in txn_doc.components:
            if comp.component == "charges":
                charges_total = charges_total + (comp.amount or 0)
            elif comp.component == "principle":
                principle_total = principle_total + (comp.amount or 0)
            elif comp.component == "interest":
                interest_total = interest_total + (comp.amount or 0)

        if txn.payment_status == "Overdue":
            overdue_days = frappe.utils.date_diff(frappe.utils.today(), txn.date_due)

            doc.append("overdue", {
                "transaction_list": txn.name,
                "type": txn.type,
                "status": txn.payment_status,
                "due_date": txn.date_due,
                "todays_date": frappe.utils.today(),
                "amount_paid": txn.emi_amount_paid,
                "total_amount": txn.emi_amount,
                "charges_total": charges_total,
                "principle_total": principle_total,
                "interest_total": interest_total,
                "overdue_days": overdue_days
            })

        if txn.payment_type in ["Paid", "Part Paid", "Excess Paid"]:
            doc.append("overall_transaction", {
                "transaction_list": txn.name,
                "type": txn.type,
                "status": txn.payment_type,
                "due_date": txn.date_due,
                "payment_date": txn.emi_payment_date,
                "amount_paid": txn.emi_amount_paid,
                "total_amount": txn.emi_amount,
                "charges_total": charges_total,
                "principle_total": principle_total,
                "interest_total": interest_total
            })

            for comp in txn_doc.components:
                if comp.component == "interest":
                    doc.append("interest", {
                        "transaction_list": txn.name,
                        "payment_date": txn.emi_payment_date,
                        "amount_paid": comp.amount_settled or 0,
                        "total_amount": comp.amount or 0,
                        "status": txn.payment_type
                    })
                elif comp.component == "principle":
                    doc.append("principle", {
                        "transaction_list": txn.name,
                        "payment_date": txn.emi_payment_date,
                        "amount_paid": comp.amount_settled or 0,
                        "total_amount": comp.amount or 0,
                        "status": txn.payment_type
                    })
                elif comp.component == "charges":
                    doc.append("charges", {
                        "transaction_list": txn.name,
                        "payment_date": txn.emi_payment_date,
                        "amount_paid": comp.amount_settled or 0,
                        "total_amount": comp.amount or 0,
                        "status": txn.payment_type
                    })

    doc.save()

# Script Type: Server Script
# Trigger: Before Save
# Doctype: Debit-Credit-Supply-Chain

# 1. Copy ROI from linked "Supply Chain account opening" if lan exists and doc.roi is empty
if doc.lan and not doc.roi:
    supply_chain_doc = frappe.get_doc("Supply Chain account opening", doc.lan)
    if supply_chain_doc.roi:
        doc.roi = supply_chain_doc.roi

# 2. Calculate due_date = disbursement_date + tenure (in days)
if doc.disbursement_date and doc.tenure:
    doc.due_date = frappe.utils.add_days(doc.disbursement_date, int(doc.tenure))

# 3. Safely calculate total_roi_amount and emi
if doc.disbursement_amount and doc.roi and doc.tenure:
    try:
        roi = float(doc.roi)
        disb_amt = float(doc.disbursement_amount)
        tenure_days = int(doc.tenure)

        doc.total_roi_amount = ((roi / 100) * disb_amt / 365) * tenure_days
        doc.emi = disb_amt + doc.total_roi_amount
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.throw(f"Calculation error: {e}")

script:
if doc.logic and doc.debit and doc.collection:

    used_debit_names = set()

    for collection in doc.collection:

        if (collection.settled_amount or 0) >= (collection.collection_amount or 0):
            continue

        if (collection.settled_amount or 0) == 0 and (collection.excess_amount or 0) == 0:
            collection.excess_amount = collection.collection_amount

        remaining_collection = float(collection.excess_amount or 0)

        for debit in doc.debit:
            if remaining_collection <= 0:
                break

            principle = float(debit.outstanding_principle_amount or 0)
            if principle <= 0:
                continue

            roi = float(debit.roi or 0)
            disbursement_date = debit.disbursement_date
            invoice_id = debit.invoice_id

            # Step 0: Compute tenure_updated
            last_payment = debit.last_payment_date or disbursement_date
            collection_date = frappe.utils.getdate(collection.collection_date)
            start_date = frappe.utils.getdate(last_payment)
            tenure_updated = 0
            if collection_date > start_date:
                tenure_updated = (collection_date - start_date).days

            # Step 1: Get interest_due from the last transaction
            past_interest_due = 0.0
            i = len(doc.transaction) - 1
            while i >= 0:
                t = doc.transaction[i]
                if t.invoice_number == invoice_id:
                    past_interest_due = float(t.interest_due or 0)
                    break
                i = i - 1

            if past_interest_due > 0:
                interest_settled = min(past_interest_due, remaining_collection)
                interest_due = past_interest_due - interest_settled
                amount_balance = float(collection.collection_amount or 0) - interest_settled
                if amount_balance < 0:
                    amount_balance = 0.0

                txn1 = doc.append("transaction", {})
                txn1.collection_date = collection.collection_date
                txn1.collection_amount = float(collection.collection_amount or 0)
                txn1.invoice_number = invoice_id
                txn1.principle = 0.0
                txn1.tenure_updated = tenure_updated
                txn1.interest = past_interest_due
                txn1.charges = 0.0
                txn1.principle_settled = 0.0
                txn1.interest_settled = interest_settled
                txn1.charges_settled = 0.0
                txn1.interest_due = interest_due
                txn1.principle_due = principle
                txn1.charges_due = 0.0
                txn1.amount_balance = amount_balance

                remaining_collection = remaining_collection - interest_settled
                used_debit_names.add(debit.name)

            if remaining_collection <= 0:
                break

            fresh_interest = 0.0
            if tenure_updated > 0 and roi > 0 and principle > 0:
                fresh_interest = (roi / 100) * principle * tenure_updated / 365

            total_interest = float(fresh_interest)

            principle_settled = 0.0
            interest_settled = 0.0
            charges = 0.0
            charges_settled = 0.0
            new_outstanding = principle

            if doc.logic == "PIC":
                if remaining_collection >= principle:
                    principle_settled = principle
                    new_outstanding = 0.0
                    remaining_collection = remaining_collection - principle
                else:
                    principle_settled = remaining_collection
                    new_outstanding = principle - remaining_collection
                    remaining_collection = 0.0

                if remaining_collection > 0:
                    to_settle = min(remaining_collection, total_interest)
                    interest_settled = to_settle
                    remaining_collection = remaining_collection - to_settle

            elif doc.logic == "IPC":
                if remaining_collection >= total_interest:
                    interest_settled = total_interest
                    remaining_collection = remaining_collection - total_interest
                else:
                    interest_settled = remaining_collection
                    remaining_collection = 0.0

                if remaining_collection > 0:
                    if remaining_collection >= principle:
                        principle_settled = principle
                        new_outstanding = 0.0
                        remaining_collection = remaining_collection - principle
                    else:
                        principle_settled = remaining_collection
                        new_outstanding = principle - remaining_collection
                        remaining_collection = 0.0

            if principle_settled > 0 or interest_settled > 0:
                principle_due = principle - principle_settled
                interest_due = total_interest - interest_settled
                charges_due = charges - charges_settled
                used_amount = principle_settled + interest_settled + charges_settled
                amount_balance = float(collection.collection_amount or 0) - used_amount
                if amount_balance < 0:
                    amount_balance = 0.0

                txn2 = doc.append("transaction", {})
                txn2.collection_date = collection.collection_date
                txn2.collection_amount = float(collection.collection_amount or 0)
                txn2.invoice_number = invoice_id
                txn2.principle = principle
                txn2.tenure_updated = tenure_updated
                txn2.interest = total_interest
                txn2.charges = charges
                txn2.principle_settled = principle_settled
                txn2.interest_settled = interest_settled
                txn2.charges_settled = charges_settled
                txn2.interest_due = interest_due
                txn2.principle_due = principle_due
                txn2.charges_due = charges_due
                txn2.amount_balance = amount_balance

                debit.outstanding_principle_amount = new_outstanding

                if principle_settled > 0:
                    debit.last_payment_date = collection.collection_date

                used_debit_names.add(debit.name)

        total_settled = 0.0
        for txn in doc.transaction:
            if txn.collection_date == collection.collection_date:
                total_settled = total_settled + float(txn.principle_settled or 0) + float(txn.interest_settled or 0)

        collection.settled_amount = total_settled
        collection.excess_amount = float(collection.collection_amount or 0) - total_settled

    for debit in doc.debit:
        if debit.name not in used_debit_names:
            has_txn = False
            total_settled = 0.0
            for txn in doc.transaction:
                if txn.invoice_number == debit.invoice_id:
                    has_txn = True
                    total_settled = total_settled + float(txn.principle_settled or 0)
            if has_txn:
                debit.outstanding_principle_amount = float(debit.disbursement_amount or 0) - total_settled
            else:
                debit.outstanding_principle_amount = float(debit.disbursement_amount or 0)

                current_disbursements = current_disbursements + disb

        row.interest = interest

        if (collection.settled_amount or 0) == 0 and (collection.excess_amount or 0) == 0:

        for debit in doc.debit:

            past_interest_due = 0.0
            for i in range(len(doc.transactions) - 1, -1, -1):
                t = doc.transactions[i]
                if t.invoice_id == debit.invoice_id and t.interest_due > 0 and not t.interest_settled:
                    past_interest_due = past_interest_due + t.interest_due

            fresh_interest = (roi / 100.0) * principle * (tenure_updated / 365.0)
            total_interest = fresh_interest + past_interest_due

            principle_due = principle
            interest_due = total_interest
            charges_due = float(debit.other_charges or 0)

            amount_balance = remaining_collection
            total_settled = 0.0

            principle_settled = min(amount_balance, principle_due)
            amount_balance = amount_balance - principle_settled

            interest_settled = min(amount_balance, interest_due)
            amount_balance = amount_balance - interest_settled

            charges_settled = min(amount_balance, charges_due)
            amount_balance = amount_balance - charges_settled

            total_settled = principle_settled + interest_settled + charges_settled
            new_outstanding = principle - principle_settled

            txn = doc.append("transactions", {})
            txn.invoice_id = debit.invoice_id
            txn.collection_id = collection.name
            txn.settled_amount = total_settled
            txn.principle_due = principle_due
            txn.interest_due = interest_due
            txn.charges_due = charges_due
            txn.principle_settled = principle_settled
            txn.interest_settled = interest_settled
            txn.charges_settled = charges_settled
            txn.remaining_principle = new_outstanding
            txn.txn_date = collection.collection_date

            collection.settled_amount = (collection.settled_amount or 0) + total_settled
            collection.excess_amount = amount_balance

            debit.outstanding_principle_amount = new_outstanding
            debit.last_payment_date = collection.collection_date

    doc.save()
